body:
# SoraMC PvP Network

Join SoraMC to play competitive Minecraft 1.21.11 PvP. You fight opponents in an optimized environment. We host our infrastructure on dedicated hardware with 99.9% measured uptime. This setup guarantees your hits register on time and your movement stays fluid.

## Combat Disciplines

Choose from multiple combat disciplines to test your skills. We offer a wide variety of gamemodes organized into three categories to keep the experience structured.

- Core Gamemodes: Sword, Axe, Mace, Vanilla, NethOP, Pot, and SMP.
- Sub Gamemodes: Diamond SMP, Spear Elytra, and Spear Mace.
- Extra Gamemodes: Sumo and Pearl Fights.

## The Tierlist System

Compete on the official SoraMC tierlist. SoraMC operates an independent tierlist system at https://soratiers.stegroup.co to guarantee fair and balanced rankings. You queue for tier testing in any available gamemode. Join our Discord server at https://soradc.stegroup.co to enter the matchmaking queue.

## Critical Server Information

Review these details before you connect:

- Supported Version: Minecraft 1.21.11
- Connection IP: soramc.stegroup.co
- Last Updated: March 13, 2026
